name: Two different match detail pages both show analysis content
description: The analysis feature should be implemented for multiple matches, not just a single hard-coded one. Two different match pages should both display populated analysis panels.

planSteps.description: Click on the first knockout bracket cell to open a match detail page and note the page URL
Click the Analysis tab and verify analysis content is present with at least one paragraph
Navigate back to the homepage using the back link or header navigation
Click on a different bracket cell to open a second match detail page
Click the Analysis tab on the second match page
Verify the second match also has analysis content with at least one paragraph of text. The two match URLs should be different.
